scope: Off-path evidence housekeeping, not benchmark capacity. Every raw file, including failed-state bytes, preserved and independently streamed/SHA256/CRC verified before removal. Sparse allocation/inode relationships are not restored. Physical device IO/latency unavailable; source bytes, archive bytes and observed filesystem free space are distinct.
compression: gzip level 1 of a tar stream; independently re-read every archived body and validate gzip CRC before removal
reproducibility: Archive is local and ignored. Committed source, pins and Make lifecycle recreate experiments; published results preserve failed verdicts. Original allocated block/sparse/inode relationships are not reproduced by tar extraction.
